handoff.objective: Review the exact gatewise source-TT compiler theorem and invariants before any producer implementation.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the streamed Hadamard induction, right-to-left exact recompression, source formula, and narrow passing and failing claims are mathematically sound.
constraints: Do not authorize implementation without an exact theorem audit and implementation-derived accounting ceiling plan.
Keep producer and exhaustive verifier paths independent.
Treat intermediate gate ranks and work as primary evidence.
Preserve the no-locator and no-ECDLP-improvement claim boundary.
End each review with exactly one concrete next action.
completion_gate: The streamed product induction and rank-factorization sweep are correct or repaired.
Every local matrix, transfer, factorization copy, direct sum, and retained core has a charge rule.
The narrowest valid passing and failing claims are explicit.
handoff.return_format: Use the repository handoff headings and end with one next concrete action.
